entity.label: Name

validators.errorMsg: Account Name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of input name should be between 1 and 100

entity.help: A unique name for this Omada controller account.

entity.label: Controller URL
entity.help: Base URL of the Omada hardware controller, including port, e.g. https://198.51.100.10:8043 (no trailing slash).

validators.errorMsg: Must be a URL starting with https:// or http://

entity.label: Omada ID (omadacId)
entity.help: The Omada ID shown via the eye icon on Settings > Platform Integration > Open API for this application (not the application's display name).

entity.label: Authentication Mode
entity.help: Matches the Open API application's mode on the controller: Client (client_credentials) for a headless service application, or Authorization Code for an application tied to a specific Omada operator account.

entity.label: Client ID
entity.help: Client ID of the Open API application.

entity.label: Client Secret
entity.help: Client Secret of the Open API application. Shown only once at creation time on the controller.

entity.label: Authorization Code
entity.help: Authorization Code mode only. One-time code obtained by visiting the controller's authorization URL in a browser, logging in as the operator this app is delegated to, and approving access. Used once on save to obtain tokens; the TA then refreshes automatically and you won't need to re-enter it unless the refresh token itself expires or is revoked.

entity.label: Redirect URI
entity.help: Authorization Code mode only. Must exactly match the redirect URI configured on the Open API application on the controller.

entity.label: Refresh Token (internal)
entity.help: Authorization Code mode only. Populated and kept current automatically after the first successful save - leave blank; do not edit.

entity.label: Verify TLS certificate
entity.help: Uncheck if the controller uses a self-signed certificate (common for local OC200 deployments).

validators.errorMsg: Max host length is 4096
Proxy Host should not have special characters
Max length of username is 50
Max length of password is 8192
Log level must be one of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL

entity.label: Name

validators.errorMsg: Input Name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of input name should be between 1 and 100

entity.help: A unique name for this data input.

entity.label: Account
entity.help: Omada controller account to use for this input.

validators.errorMsg: Length of account name should be between 1 and 100

entity.label: Interval

validators.errorMsg: Interval must be either a non-negative number, CRON interval or -1.
Interval must be between 30 and 86400

entity.help: Polling interval in seconds. The local Open API has an undocumented daily call quota - 60s across all sites/devices can exhaust it quickly; raise this if you see 429/quota errors in the TA log.

entity.label: Fields
entity.help: Select which fields to ingest for this input. The list is fetched live from the controller via the selected Account once one is chosen, reflecting whatever this firmware actually returns rather than a fixed guess - refreshes automatically if you change the Account. Leave empty to ingest every field. A small set of identifying fields (e.g. mac/name/site) is always included in the ingested data regardless of this selection, even if not checked here, so records stay correlatable.

entity.label: Site ID filter (optional)
entity.help: Comma-separated Omada site IDs to restrict collection to. Leave blank to collect all sites visible to this account.
